name: School Rendezvous
original_name: School Rendezvous (スクールランデブー)
source:
A School Rumble fan-fiction.

Tsukamoto Tenma is the girl the bad body Harima fell in love with. But he happened to have sex with the rival Sawachika and Tenma's beloved young sister Yakumo, despite just happened to turn out this way.

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE018636.html]DLsite english[/url]]
translation:
《校园迷糊大王》同人作品。

冢本天满是坏男孩播磨爱上的女孩。但他却碰巧和对手泽近以及天满心爱的妹妹八云发生了关系，虽然事情就是这么巧。
